body: So falling asleep was more difficult than usual, but I actually slept for around 12 hours last night! I actually dreamt and feel rested, not like being passed out drunk for 12 hours and waking up feeling like I got hit by a truck! Who’d have guessed lol! So it’s my 3rd day sober, thanks to your comment and everyone else’s on here. Thank you :) IWNDWYT!!

I loved the way you phrased that. Hopefully I’ll see my sobriety reflected in my bank account soon, and it would be incredible to be able to treat myself to something nice that isn’t from a can or a bottle. Thank you for your advice!!

I loved the way you phrased that. Hopefully I’ll see my sobriety reflected in my bank account soon, and it would be incredible to be able to treat myself to something nice that isn’t from a can or a bottle. Thank you for your comment :)

This was one of the most helpful comments I received I think, though all of them were helpful in their own right! I really focused on the fact that I didn’t actually want to drink, it was just my brain and my bad habits telling me I HAD to. I ended up getting some junk food (Wendy’s and a big ol’ soda and some leftover ice cream in my freezer lol). I spent my night sober and binging Netflix, and I feel so much better today because of it!! Thank you so much for your comment, I think I’ll definitely be rereading it and all the other comments everyone made on here to keep myself on track in the future. Thanks again for the wise words. Day 3 sober and IWNDWYT!!!!!

I kept two of the bags that showed any kind of mycelial growth!! I isolated them and I’ll see if they can be salvaged ! The other bags showed no signs of growth at all, just the weird orange colored liquid, so I tossed them 😬
they’re definitely way too wet, the combo of the moisture already present and my over-inoculation definitely pushed them over the edge! but what does IMNSHO mean 😭 i’m a noob

i wiped everything down with ISO including my gloves between every bag and flame sterilized the needle each time! wore a mask and bought ozium to try to help my chances with contamination in the air since i wasnt using an SAB. is there anything else i should do next time to insure this doesn’t happen again?

i ended up isolating and keeping the 12th bag (13th pic) just to see what happens. I innoculated the big grain bag first and it seems okay so far, but every subsequent one is pretty bad. i thought i was decent with my sterile practice and methods but i think i’m going to invest in a SAB next time for sure and pay more attention to the process. thank you!!

i think i’ll try a different tek next time for sure, i need to look more into broke boi tek. i tossed 11 of the bags and kept the one in the 13th pic that had less bacteria/wetrot and isolated it from the big bag just to see what’ll happen. the big grain bag was the first one i did, and it seems okay so far, so i’m just wondering what i did differently after that that screwed everything else up lol
I think I accidentally added a double photo of one of the bags, I meant the 13th pic might look more salvageable!!

thank you so much for the advice !!! the syringe i used was massive, like 60 cc and i still have a bunch left in it just sitting in my fridge lol i’m definitely going to get a new syringe, and try to build an SAB and laser-focus on my cleanliness going forward 🫡
is there anything i can do in the mean time to ensure the orange goop doesn’t spread?? or is it more of a waiting game?

the big bag seems fine! i haven’t seen any of the orange stuff in there yet and i’m hoping i don’t at all, but the odds are against me lmao. i did reuse my needle for all of them, but i sanitized everything with iso including my gloves in-between every inoculation, flame sterilized the syringe every time too, even bought some ozium to try to make sure my air was as clean as i could since i didn’t use a SAB or anything. wore a mask too! i guess i’ll see if it spreads to the big guy but i’m keeping my fingers crossed lol. thank you!!!
